subtasks.title: make the trailing newline not count as a line
subtasks.goal: Fix count::lines in src/count.rs. A text that ends with a newline has as many lines as it has newline characters; a text without a trailing newline has as many lines as it has newlines plus one. The empty string stays at zero. The repository's tests/behaviour.rs already asserts this and is currently red; make it pass without editing the test file.

dod.statement: tests/behaviour.rs asserts the trailing-newline rule and passes, and the existing tests in src/count.rs stay green
